steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Can you do that again? Yeah, that.

steps.speaker: Enterprise A Rep
steps.content: Our sincerest apologies for the inconvenience! We'll assign more staff to fix the bugs right away!
The Enterprise A representative drops to his knees, bowing until his forehead nearly touches the ground.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Lower. I've seen other Syndicate gangsters do that better.

steps.speaker: Enterprise A Rep
steps.content: Our sincerest apologies for the inconvenience! The server maintenance compensation has been sent to your inbox. Please note that the email expires in seven days. Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No idea. Probably just survival instinct kicking in.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So... do we still have to pay?

steps.speaker: Enterprise A Rep
steps.content: No, no... Please keep playing our games once we’ve fixed the bugs—that’s all we ask!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sounds good. So when are you going to add Eastside and Paradeisos to this world, anyway?

steps.speaker: Enterprise A Rep
steps.content: Um… Well, we’re working hard to improve our capacity. We sincerely apologize!
The Enterprise A representative's forehead meets the ground again with an audible thud.
